items: Farming claims faster: with a pull set (ranged attack, Provoke, a spell), the farmer uses it as soon as the mob is in reach instead of walking up first - so it's yours sooner and comes to you.
The Farming tab now opens in a Simple view with just what you need; "All settings" shows everything.

Behind the scenes: a farming simulator now plays out whole farming sessions in the tests (walking, walls, claims, rests, routes), so problems like "not moving to attack" get caught before they reach you.
Farming: spot rotation. Save a few farm spots in a zone and tick "move on to the next saved spot" - when one runs dry for 3 minutes, the farmer walks to the next.
A small chart shows kills per 5 minutes over the last hour, so you can see when a spot slows down.
The checklist now warns when a spot is busy (most mobs belong to other players) and when Reraise or food is missing.
Farming checklist: green ticks and red crosses show exactly why the farmer is or isn't pulling - mobs picked, camp set, mobs nearby, party ready, resting, bag space.
Treasure Hunter: tick it (or use the Item farming quick setup) and GearSwap tags each mob with your TH gear while farming.
The radar can zoom (Fit, 30, 60, 120 yalms). New tiles: CP per hour and free bag spaces.
Farming: Quick setups. One click sets everything for an XP / CP party, item farming, safe and careful farming, or clearing everything around the camp.
No more getting stuck on a mob: if the farmer is fighting something it can't reach (no damage for 25 seconds, out of reach) or someone else claims it, it lets go and moves on.
Farming: Past runs. Every farming run is kept at the bottom of the Farming tab - how long, kills, kills per hour, XP / CP, loot and why it stopped.
Too strong: a kind of mob that takes your farmer under 25% HP or over 3 minutes (twice), or KOs it, is set aside automatically. It shows in purple on the radar; click ↺ to fight it again.
Extra mobs joining a fight: one click and everyone who can sleep them will.
Farming is steadier: the farmer no longer gets pulled back by following or assisting someone else, it helps a party member who gets attacked, and it stops cleanly if it changes zone.
⚡ Quick start: one click farms the most common mob around you, with the camp where you stand.
Click a mob on the radar to fight that kind or leave it alone.
Stop after a set time, and choose what happens when done: stay, everyone warps home, or everyone logs out. The Alarms ring when farming stops or has had nothing to fight for 5 minutes.
Trusts are now sorted by role in the trust menu: Tank, Healer, Support, Melee, Ranged, Caster.
Farming: XP / CP chains. The Farming tab shows your chain number, how long since the last kill and your best chain. Vanguard learns how long the chain window is from your own kills.
"Keep the XP / CP chain going" (under The team): while a chain is running, it only waits for the party in a real emergency (HP under 40% or MP under 15%), so the chain doesn't break.
Farming: "Which mob is worth it". While you farm, Vanguard learns how long each kind of mob takes to kill and how much XP / CP it gives, and shows the best one with a star.
Tick "Prefer the mob that pays best" and when several mobs are near, it goes for the kind that gives the most points per minute.
Farming: bring each mob back to camp. Tick it under Where - the farmer pulls, runs back to camp with the mob following, and fights it there.
Your other characters wait at camp instead of running out to the mob, and join in when it arrives (like a real FFXI party puller).
Farming: see what dropped. The Farming tab now shows "Loot this run" - everything that came into your bags while farming.

Farm for an item: under Stop when, pick an item (from your bags or what dropped) and how many - e.g. 12 Beastmen's Seals. A progress bar shows how close you are, and farming stops by itself when you have them.
Fixed: picking a weapon skill (like Atonement) on Job & abilities turned weapon skills off and the menu jumped back. It sets the weapon skill now.
Farming: "Fight mobs within" now goes up to 500 yalms (in steps of 50 after 50).

Farming fix: the farmer now walks to its mob. Before, when the mob was far away it kept trying to attack from where it stood and never moved. Now it walks up, attacks once it's close enough, walks right up if that didn't work, and skips a mob it can't reach instead of getting stuck on it.

Farming: avoid packs. A mob with others standing next to it can bring them along, so the farmer now picks mobs on their own first. Farming tab > How to fight (on by default, pick how close counts as "next to it").
"Never pull one with others next to it" makes it wait until a mob is alone; those show purple on the radar. Mobs already attacking you are always fought.

Farming rebuilt from the ground up. The Farming tab now opens with a live radar (your camp, the mobs coloured by what farming will do with them, your party) and the run's numbers: time, kills, kills per hour, a kill every N seconds, XP per hour.
It stays in one place: a camp it returns to after each kill (or a route you record). Mobs it can't reach (can't see them, can't get closer) are skipped instead of chased forever.
It waits for the party before each pull - the healer's MP, everyone's HP, everyone close - and tells whoever is low to rest. "Others follow and help" sets the whole team up in one click.

Three ways to farm: mobs you pick, only what attacks you, or anything nearby. Stop when the inventory is full or after a number of kills. Save the whole farm as a spot and load it next time with one click.
Fixed: drop-down menus (like "Finish with") closed by themselves before you could pick something. They stay open now.
Fixed: red "bridge error ... vg_bridge.lua:98" lines filling the chat every second (from the new Cooldowns box). Cooldowns work now.
Fixed: Geomancer's "Dia first" (get on the hate list before a Geo debuff) never happened in game. It does now.
If something does go wrong talking to the app, it's shown once a minute and listed under App & updates > Problems instead of filling the chat.
New: Cooldowns on the Team tab. Every character's job abilities on one screen: green ones are ready - click one and that character uses it - grey ones show the time left.
"Only the long ones" keeps it short: 1-hour abilities and the ones with long recasts (Sentinel, Convert, Elemental Seal...).

Farming redesigned, EasyFarm-easy: it has its own Farming tab now. 1) What to fight - Look around and click Fight these. 2) Where - how far to look, and an optional route you record by walking it. 3) How - pull with Provoke, Flash, a ranged attack or just walk up, and when to rest. Then one Start farming button.
The top of the Farming tab says what it's doing right now: going for a mob, fighting, resting, walking the route - or that you still need to pick what to fight.
Farming also has 4) Trusts - click the trusts to call between fights - and "Walk up to the mob before attacking".

New: Finish mobs with a weapon skill (Job & abilities and Farming tabs). Pick e.g. Atonement and the HP% - the character saves its TP and lands that weapon skill as the killing blow. The other characters stop attacking that mob when it gets low, and a tank can wait for TP if the mob gets low too early.
Fixed: automatic updates could get stuck on an old version ("Access is denied"). The window also refreshes by itself after an update.
Fixed: a character could show "running" right after loading even with Auto start off. Now only Auto start starts it by itself.
Fixed: deleting a saved team setup could bring it back later.

Fixed: "Something went wrong (event action / ipc message / incoming text)" messages filling the chat. Since the crash-report version, Vanguard's events lost their details in game, so the characters couldn't react to fights, each other or chat. Everything works again.

New: Go home on the Team tab. Warp everyone, just the alts, or one character home with two clicks. Each character uses what it has: the Warp spell, an Instant Warp scroll, or a Warp Ring (put on, used when it's ready, and GearSwap kept off the ring until it zones).
The box shows each character's way home, and "none" in red if it has no way to warp.

New: Alarms. The app plays a sound, shows a red banner and flashes the character's card when one of your characters is KO'd, asleep, petrified or charmed, goes offline (disconnected), or is stuck behind or not fighting. It works even while the app is minimized behind the game.
Low HP and low MP alarms too (tick them and pick the %), and "Keep ringing until I click OK" for when you step away. App & updates > Alarms; Test sound to hear it.
Logging out with the Log out button or the stop timer doesn't set it off.

New: Enemy watch on the Team tab. See what your characters are fighting: its HP, distance, the TP move it readies, and every enfeeble - green landed, yellow being cast, red resisted, grey not tried yet.
When two characters fight the same enemy it shows once, with everything both of them know.

New: keep MP for cures (an idea healer tools like CurePlease share). Healing & MP / Recovery tab: "Keep MP for cures" - below that MP the character stops casting buffs, songs, enfeebles and nukes, and saves the rest for Cures, Raise and status removal. Off (0) unless you set it.
The Vanguard page now says it plainly: Vanguard is free and always will be - no paid features, subscriptions, keys, ads or donations.

New: Skillchain builder on the Team tab. Pick each step's character and weapon skill from menus (only weapon skills that character has); the app shows each one's properties, what every step makes (e.g. Gravitation, then Darkness) or "no skillchain", and which magic bursts it opens. "Use this skillchain" sets it on everyone.
No more typing "Character:Weapon Skill" lines.

New: crash reports. Errors in the addon (on any character) and in the app are now caught instead of breaking things, with exactly where they happened. A "problem" badge appears at the top; App & updates > Problems > Send report opens a ready-made report on the Vanguard GitHub page - click Submit and it reaches the developer so it can be fixed.
Character names and your Windows user name are replaced before anything is shown or sent, and nothing is sent without your click. "Report a problem" works for things that go wrong without an error.

New: Upkeep table on the Team tab - for each character, pick the food to keep up, how to keep Reraise up and which mount to ride, from menus of what that character really has (food in its bags, the Reraise spells it can cast and Reraise items it owns, the mounts it owns). No more typing item names.
This was the last of 10 hourly updates researched from paid tools (ISBoxer, MMOMinion and the paid script programs).

New: share profiles with friends (paid tools like MMOMinion have profile downloads). On the profile bar, Export… saves a profile as a file with the normal Windows Save window; Import… adds a file a friend sent you.
Exported files leave out which character they came from and who the leader is; an imported profile never overwrites one of yours (it becomes "Name (2)").

New: Reactions builder on the Advanced tab (like the skill editors in paid tools). Pick When (my HP / MP below, TP at least, someone's HP below, the enemy's HP below, the enemy readies or casts something it was seen using, I have / don't have a buff, fighting or not), Do (a spell, ability, weapon skill or item, on whom) and How often - all from menus.
Reactions are listed in plain words with an x to remove them, and are saved properly now.

New: pick farm mobs by clicking (like MMOMinion's grind lists). Advanced tab > Farming > Look around lists the mobs near a character - how many, how close, who claimed them - with Fight these / Leave alone buttons. No more typing mob names.
The farm lists show as tags with an x to remove; a mob is on one list or the other, never both.

New: hotkeys for quick buttons (like ISBoxer's key maps). Give any quick button Ctrl or Alt + a number from a menu; pressing it in the game window you play makes that button's character act - no need to click the app.
Hotkeys are set in the leader's game window by default (you can pick another), and are removed when the button is.
New: ability priority, like MMOMinion's Skill Manager. The Job tab lists the abilities in the order they're tried - top first - with up / down / to-the-top arrows next to each one, and Reset order.
The order is saved per job and travels with profiles.

New: Stop timer on the Team tab (paid script programs call it "stop after run time"). Pick "after 2 hours" or "at 3 AM", then whether to just stop or stop and log out, for everyone or only the alts. A countdown shows at the top.
It runs in the app, so it works with the window minimized; logging out uses the normal /logout.

New: Party board on the Team tab - every character's HP, MP, TP, what it's doing and all its buffs in one place, so you don't need to look at the other game windows (the job ISBoxer's window views do).
Ailments show in red, also on the character cards on the left. Click one and a character who can cure it casts the right spell (Paralyna, Cursna for Doom, Erase, ...).

New: quick buttons (like ISBoxer's click bars). On the Team tab pick who, what (a spell, ability, weapon skill, item, attack, follow or stop) and on whom - all from menus - and it becomes a button in a bar at the top. One click makes that character do it, without switching windows.
Buttons can be for one character or everyone, moved left / right and removed.

New: session stats for every character on the Team tab - experience, Capacity Points and limit points per hour, kills, deaths and time. Reset starts a new session. (Paid tools like MMOMinion and the RuneScape script clients all show these.)
New: this What's new tab, so you can see what each update adds or fixes.
Bard: a third dummy song, so with 5 song slots (Daurdabla + Clarion Call) it sings 2 songs, the 3 dummies, then songs 3-5.
Bard: 5 song menus and a "5 songs" option; under Clarion Call all 5 songs are sung.
Bard: Honor March and Aria of Passion show up when you own Marsyas / Loughnashade.
Bard: "+ Add someone" for Pianissimo songs (alliance members, your other characters, players nearby).
New: Auto start switch at the top (off by default) - characters only start by themselves when it's on.
Bard: the dummy song menus are always there.
Bard rebuilt after the Singer addon: song slots from your harp, dummy songs, Marcato before the song you pick, the Clarion Call song, Pianissimo per member, waiting for the party to be in range.
Stratagems: one grid - tick which spells get Perpetuance, Accession, Celerity, Penury and the rest.
Healing: tick which Cure and Curaga tiers are used, and pick the HP amounts from menus.
Fixed: the red "is not defined for strings" error on Scholars.
Fixed: switching a character to Scholar now shows up in the app.
New: Scholar stratagems for SCH main job and /SCH - charges by level, a reserve for emergencies, Light / Dark Arts kept up.
New: profiles like CurePlease - save a character's whole setup, load it on anyone, or have it load by itself for a job.
New: thresholds next to every ability, cure tiers, rest / Convert / Sublimation settings.
The app installs and updates the Vanguard addon by itself; Team tab with every team order.
